verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a remote-desktop service, but nothing in the evidence shows Parsec's core service (accounts, control plane, brokering) can be deployed on your own infrastructure. 'Hosting' in the docs means sharing your own machine as a session host. Peer-to-peer connections and an Enterprise relay placed in your firewall are adjacent features, not self-hosting of the core product, and community evidence notes the source is closed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
